total_weight_is_zero.meaning: IVoter(voter).totalWeight() equals zero at the time notifyRewardAmount transfers rewards

pool_live_weight_is_zero.meaning: the pool's live weight equals zero when _updateForAfterDistribution runs

index_delta_tokens_stranded.meaning: tokens associated with the index delta remain stranded in the manager rather than being accruable by gauges or returned to the minter
index_delta_tokens_stranded.checkpoint: after reward notification and per-pool distribution

assumptions: notifyRewardAmount transfers rewards into GaugeManager before the per-pool distribution step
_updateForAfterDistribution is the per-pool distribution step that runs after the reward transfer

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the zero-total-weight and zero-live-weight scenario was observed in a live transaction or is only conditional; the plan treats it as the stated conditional scenario.
Exact token amounts and epoch ranges affected by the stranded index delta are not quantified.

limitations: The stranded-token observable is a report-grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric index-delta or token amount to bind.
Caller/authorization for notifyRewardAmount and _updateForAfterDistribution is unspecified and not encoded.
